findings: Header digest deliberately ignores body unless separate body hasher selected. Same normalized subject/date-day/addresses/content-type yields same header digest for unequal bodies; raw-body control distinguishes them.

Normalized body removes all whitespace and line boundaries; ab c and a bc share normalized digest. Raw body still normalizes line endings and trailing newline through splitlines/join. Domain equivalence is not exact encoded-file identity.
Canonical size counts Python decoded characters without line separators, not encoded bytes: two Cyrillic characters size2 versus UTF8 payload4.

dehydrate memoizes scalar size and timestamp; hydrate copies parsed message attributes from source without invalidating those scalars. Synthetic in-memory replacement aa->abcdefghij with changed date yields new10-character body with old size2 and old timestamp. No actual mailbox race qualification.

All24 strategy enum members resolve to callable implementation; time/size/path criteria may select multiple tied copies. Random strategies are explicitly nondeterministic. Resolution control is not an original test suite run.
harness_notes: Initial Unicode fixture passed Python str and failed the expected decoded-character assertion. Corrected harness to feed UTF8 bytes through normal Message decoding; original source unchanged and final assertions pass.
transfer_decision: Keep exact encoded-byte equality separate from mail normalization; bind content-derived metadata to the same verified observation. No foreign production code copied.
